component.name: Lunduke Edit
component.summary: A light GTK3 text editor for Linux X11

description.p: Lunduke Edit is a classic menubar text editor for the Lunduke Computer Operating System. Look and feel: Windows 95 Notepad, Macintosh SimpleText, and BBEdit Lite — with GtkSourceView undo, Find & Replace, and Print.

Save, open, print, find, and undo fixes. Debian package 0.8-2. A failed save no longer truncates the file or looks saved. Save As keeps the confirmed path. Non-UTF-8 files keep their encoding. Opening a file asks before dropping unsaved edits, and every command-line file is opened. Short reads, print clipping, line-number scrolling, File → Exit, Replace undo, Find Next, Start at Top, Selection Only, Extend Selection replace, the unsaved marker, Go to Line, and tab columns are fixed.
LCOS 0.8 track identity bump (0.7-5 → 0.8 / Debian 0.8-1). Features and UI unchanged.
Find fixes: Search Selection Only stays in selection; Extend Selection grows across matches; Edit → Find. Package 0.7-5.
Find & Replace dialog: tighter Search For entry→checkbox gap; Find button aligns with Search For entry. Package 0.7-4.
Find & Replace dialog layout tweaks: tighter labels, Cancel bottom-right, aligned checkbox column. Package 0.7-3.
Find & Replace dialog spacing/alignment tidy (layout only). Package 0.7-2.
Lunduke Edit 0.7 for LCOS 0.7. Identity bump plus app icon (org.lunduke.LundukeEdit hicolor PNGs 16–512). No feature changes vs 0.3.2.
Blank untitled on first launch (no sample seed). File→New blank; Save As default Untitled.txt.
Fix Undo/Redo menu sensitivity; Save As no longer doubles .txt.
Print (Ctrl+P) and Page Setup via Gtk::PrintOperation. Debian packaging for overlay apt.
